BILLING MODEL

Two layers keep billing understandable.

Platform subscription

The platform plan controls users, workspace limits, feature access and company-level entitlements. Choose the access the team needs for conversations, contacts and campaign preparation. Final paid prices and exact limits will be published before launch.

Managed services

Managed email and SMS have a separate usage layer based on sending and applicable rates. A workspace plan should not be interpreted as unlimited or free delivery. Confirm sender readiness, supported routes and final usage terms before budgeting a campaign.

Advertising spend

Google and Meta media spend stays with the connected advertising providers. Platform access organizes the campaign workflow; it does not pay for the ads. Review account permissions and provider budgets alongside the workspace plan.

PLAN THE WORK FIRST

Evaluate access and delivery separately.

Start with the team size, company controls and workflows you need. Then estimate the volume and channels of customer outreach. Managed messaging costs depend on the provider and sending setup; external advertising budgets remain a separate decision.

The Free, Starter and Growth cards show the current plan direction. Public sign-up is coming soon. Paid prices, final entitlements, usage rates and billing terms must be confirmed before purchase.

PRACTICAL QUESTIONS

Know what each cost covers.

Does the Free plan include free email or SMS delivery?

The ₹0 card describes platform access. Managed email and SMS usage are separate, and no free sending allowance is promised here. Final rates and entitlements will be published before public launch.

Are Google Ads and Meta Ads budgets part of the subscription?

No. Media spend stays with Google and Meta. The UnifyDesk plan concerns workspace access and supported workflows, while the connected provider account carries its advertising budget.

Can I buy Starter or Growth today?

Public sign-up and paid pricing are coming soon. Use the product tour to evaluate the developing workspace. Paid prices, exact limits and commercial terms will be available before launch.

CHANNEL WORKFLOWS

Match your sending plan to the channel.

Email campaigns

For teams planning newsletters, product updates and other permission-based email outreach. Prepare content and sending readiness together, while keeping connected personal or team inboxes separate from campaign infrastructure.

SMS marketing

For teams planning permission-based announcements and promotional updates. The workflow brings the customer audience and campaign draft together while keeping sender, template and delivery requirements visible.

WhatsApp broadcast

For marketing and operations teams planning relevant updates to customers who have agreed to hear from them. Keep audience selection and campaign review separate from the daily work of replying to individual conversations.
